fusions.name: Dull Incantation
fusions.desc: Flicks a rune-cut chip that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance of [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Word of Weight
fusions.desc: Speaks a word of weight, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Rewound Sigil
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is turned aside and sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Cadence
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You have 8% earth resistance.
